_comment: Judge drift fixtures (MTR-184, doc 07 §B). Each entry is a frozen clay render (renders/<id>.png) with HAND-ASSIGNED scores that encode the intended rubric calibration. scripts/evals/drift.ts re-judges the live model against these and fails when it drifts past tolerance — insurance for a model upgrade on the critique role. dims use the real AESTHETIC_DIMENSIONS (0-5); aggregate is the intended 0-100. Add the render PNGs (produced by the sidecar) alongside this file to activate a fixture; entries without a render are reported as pending, not failed.

fixtures.note: A restrained squircle desk enclosure with one uniform wall, crisp port cutout, cohesive single form — the taste target.
A generative-accident blob with a stray unmerged boss floating beside the body — disjointed, should score at/below the cohesion floor.
A functional L-bracket that is valid and recognizable but visually soft/mushy from over-large fillets and inconsistent edge treatment — a middling score.
